source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find Junior Sister Meng (Secrets of the Baishan Sect)
source_excerpt:
Secrets of the Baishan Sect in Phantom Blade Zero is one of the tales players will pick up early in the Crimson Forest after talking to Ju and Lanlan. They'll plead with Soul to save their junior sister Meng, who's trapped underneath the mountain lodge. Here's how players can find junior sister Meng in the Phantom Blade Zero Secrets of Baishan Sect quest.
How to Start Secrets of Baishan Sect in Phantom Blade Zero
Right after players beat the "Jing Ye, the Outlaw" boss in Crimson Forest, they'll eventually cross a rope bridge east of the Outlaw's Trap bell .
You'll encounter two sisters, Ju and Lanlan , arguing with each other on the bridge. Talking to Lanlan will start the Secrets of Baishan Sect quest in Phantom Blade Zero . You'll need to find their junior sister Meng at the mountain lodge.
To find junior sister Meng, you'll need to progress through the Crimson Forest normally until you end up at the mountain lodge east of the Thieves' Den (location marked on the map image above).
How to Get Crimson Forest Cellar Crank
Once you reach the mountain lodge, enter inside, and you'll find a mechanism that will require the Crimson Forest Cellar Crank in the Phantom Blade Zero Secrets of Baishan Sect quest.
To find the crank, you'll need to head through the archway to the left of the lodge and enter the backyard. After activating the bell behind the lodge, go up the ladder and enter the upper section of the lodge.
You'll need to defeat a couple of enemies in this area, and then break the broken wooden door to enter the main living space. The area is covered in poison fog , so you'll need to quickly pick up the Crimson Forest Cellar Crank and jump outside the lodge.
How to Get Crimson Forest Secret Chamber Crank
Now, use the cellar crank to open up the secret passage in the ground floor of the lodge and head down. There are a couple of enemies here, including a Butcher, so defeat them first before moving forward.
After heading down towards the quest marker, you'll come across yet another mechanism that will now require you to find the Crimson Forest Secret Chamber Crank .
Head back to the main area and climb up the platform to your right. Once you're on the elevated platform, you'll be able to see the Secret Chamber Crank lying next to a body in the open cell.
Don't forget to also check the Thieves' Camp Dungeon key that I've also marked in the image above.
Now use the Crimson Forest Secret Chamber Crank to open up the door and rescue junior sister Meng in the Phantom Blade Zero Secrets of Baishan Sect quest.
This will complete the Crimson Forest part of the Secrets of Baishan Sect, and now you will need to progress in the game until you unlock the Mandate Encampment . But for now, you can either progress through the area as normal, or head back to the bridge outside Thieves' Camp for a special encounter .
